prompt_en: A vertically oriented literary poster in a muted sepia, ash, and parchment palette with dramatic gold kintsugi-style cracks running diagonally across the entire composition. The background is a soft textured paper and watercolor wash with smoky clouds, worn stains, and faint marbling. In the upper left, place a large faded monochrome portrait bust of an older Indian man in traditional formal attire, partially emerging from the mist like a historical figure or poet, softly blended into the background. In the upper right, set a small Hindi title line परशुराम की प्रतीक्षा with a smaller author credit below it, elegant and understated. He has a bare muscular torso, long wild dark hair blown upward, and a tattered deep red drape wrapped across his body and trailing dramatically to the right in torn ribbons. He holds 1 large battle axe in his left hand, the blade angled downward, suggesting Parashurama. Surround him with dust, smoke, tiny debris, and painterly splashes. Add 2 vertical blocks of smaller Hindi poem text, one on the lower left and one on the lower right of the warrior, balanced like a printed poetry poster. Keep the poem text dense and readable but secondary to the central quote and figure. Use painterly digital illustration with fine art poster aesthetics, soft atmospheric lighting, high contrast around the warrior, and subtle glowing gold fissures crossing through the portrait, text area, rocks, and fabric. The sky is saturated cyan-blue with comic dots. At the very top, place huge arched yellow block letters reading CHENGDU, with black shadow and outline; directly underneath add red Chinese characters 成都 flanked by two red dots. In the upper right, add a red circular passport stamp that says “WELCOME TO CHENGDU” with a cute panda face and three wavy postal cancellation lines. The scene should show exactly 5 cream-and-peach puffy clouds: one large cloud on the upper left, one large cloud on the upper right, one partial cloud entering from the left middle edge, one small cloud left of center, and one small cloud right of center. Center the postcard around Chengdu landmarks: a tall TV tower rising from behind a giant faceted panda-head building, with a blue doorway at the panda’s mouth; make the panda head geometric and stone-like with black ears and eye patches. Along the lower skyline, include colorful simplified city buildings and green trees. On the left foreground, include a traditional Chinese pavilion with green tiled roofs, red lanterns, and a sign with Chinese characters. On the right foreground, include a yellow vertical sign with Chinese characters 太古里. Across the bottom, draw a bright blue river with wavy white highlights and an arched cream stone bridge on the right. In the bottom left foreground, place a roadside sign reading “I ♥ CHENGDU” and a cute standing panda mascot waving beside it. Counted visible elements: 1 main headline, 1 Chinese subtitle, 1 red passport stamp, 5 clouds, 1 central TV tower, 1 giant panda-head building, 1 traditional pavilion, 1 vertical landmark sign, 1 river, 1 arched bridge, 1 “I love Chengdu” sign, and 1 waving panda mascot. prompt_en:
Subject: Seaside sunset

Person/Expression: Woman in her 20s. Bright ivory-beige white skin with smooth texture and natural pinkish complexion. Soft highlights on cheeks, nose, shoulders, and collarbone, preserving natural skin grain without excessive retouching. Elegant doll-like Japanese makeup, pale rose pink blush, champagne beige and pink-brown eye shadow, long thin eyelashes, natural eye bags, light brown eyebrows, translucent pink-beige lip gloss. Clear small catchlights in eyes. Smiling gently and looking directly at the camera.

Outfit/Pose: Pale cream beige off-shoulder setup. The top features sheer chiffon sleeves, modest lacing at the chest with fine ruffles, and a design that follows the body's natural lines. The bottom is a matching wrap-style mini skirt with a soft ribbon tie at the waist. The right hand lightly touches the hair near the ear, and the left hand rests naturally on the edge of a wooden table. The body is turned slightly to the left of the frame, with only the upper body twisted toward the camera. One leg is extended forward, creating a natural center of gravity and sense of contact in the seated posture.

Background/Light: A wooden deck at a Japanese seaside cafe reminiscent of the Enoshima area. Sunset and reflections on the sea surface in the back left, with a small lighthouse and seaside cityscape in the distance. A wooden cafe exterior, warm lanterns, foliage, and a blackboard menu in the back right. On the table is a transparent plastic cup of iced tea, a black straw, a round cafe logo, and reflections of ice and lemon. The sunset enters low from the back left, lighting the hair outline, shoulders, cheeks, collarbones, and water droplets on the glass in golden tones. Shadows fall long toward the bottom right, and soft reflected light from the sea slightly lifts the shadows on the skin and clothing.

Composition/Camera: Vertical composition, medium-range portrait including the upper body to thighs. The subject is positioned slightly right of center, with the face near the upper rule-of-thirds line. The table and hands are in the bottom left, leaving plenty of sea and sunset in the background. Shot naturally from slightly below eye level with a 35mm-equivalent slight wide-angle feel. Sharp focus on the face and upper body, with the background lightly blurred but enough to perceive the atmosphere of the Enoshima cafe.

Texture/Style: Realistic Japanese photography style. Skin is smooth but retains pores and fine shadows, not plastic-like. Hair is bright milk tea ash brown with thin see-through bangs, layer-cut along the face, medium-long to below the shoulders. Ends are loosely curled inward, carefully expressing natural bundles, fine highlights, soft shine, and a small amount of stray hairs. Warm tones like a sunset film photo, soft contrast, and delicate grain.

Negative: Unnatural face or gaze, excessive beauty correction, clothing failure, extra or missing fingers, fused limbs, joint failure, distorted drinks or straws, garbled text, broken logos, unnatural perspective, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive background distortion, unnecessary people, watermarks.\

title: 四面板银行世界故事板
author: AIライフハック
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,3D 渲染,电影感 / 电影剧照,建筑 / 室内,角色
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a polished 2x2 storyboard-style image sheet for a short video scene about the despair of a zero bank balance, set in a modern blue-themed bank world.

Canvas: Square 1:1 composition, four equal panels separated by clean white gutters, bright cinematic 3D-rendered realism with slightly idealized commercial lighting, high detail, sharp focus, saturated blue bank branding, no captions or speech bubbles.

Layout: Use exactly 4 panels in a grid.
1. Top-left panel: Interior ATM area with exactly 3 visible ATM machines in a row, each built into gray wall bays with bold blue vertical dividers. The nearest ATM screen prominently shows a large red “0” on a pale cyan screen, implying an empty balance. Include tiled floor, ceiling lights, and a small potted plant in the background.
2. Top-right panel: Bank service counter with exactly 1 female bank clerk seated behind a beige stone counter. She wears a navy suit, white shirt, blue striped scarf or tie, and a small gold nameplate. Her face is intentionally featureless/softly blurred for anonymity. Include exactly 1 computer monitor, 1 keyboard, 1 blue document tray, and 1 potted plant on or near the counter. Behind her are glass office partitions, blue chairs, certificates on the wall, and warm office lighting.
3. Bottom-left panel: Exterior of a contemporary city bank branch on a sunny street corner. Show a blue horizontal sign band above glass doors, gray stone facade, street crosswalk markings, sidewalk bollards, leafy trees, and black street lamps. The entrance should feel clean, corporate, and Japanese urban but without readable signage.
4. Bottom-right panel: Fantasy bank vault interior with an oversized round open vault door in bronze and steel. Inside the vault are stacks of cash and gold, warm golden lighting, shelves, and treasure props. Include exactly 3 small cute animal mascots standing near the vault entrance, wearing colorful tiny outfits, plus visible piles of bundled banknotes, coins, a chest, and a money bag.

Visual style: High-end 3D illustration, cinematic render, bank commercial aesthetic mixed with whimsical storybook detail in the vault panel, realistic materials, glossy glass, polished stone, metallic vault surfaces, warm highlights, deep blue brand accents.

Subject details: The bank’s dominant brand color is royal blue. The ATM screen should display 0 in red. The bank clerk outfit should be navy suit with blue striped scarf. The vault should contain bundled cash, coins, treasure chest, and money bag.

Constraints: No extra panels, no visible watermarks, no logos, no readable text except the red balance number on the ATM screen, keep the four-panel sheet coherent as one bank-themed storyboard, maintain clean white borders between panels.\

title: 浮世绘骷髅工薪族语录海报 - 1

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a dark, highly detailed Japanese ukiyo-e style poster featuring a skeletal salaryman as a grim motivational figure, combining Edo-period woodblock print texture with modern corporate burnout satire.

Canvas: Vertical poster, roughly 4:5 aspect ratio, aged parchment background with heavy black border, weathered paper stains, ink splatter, scratches, distressed print grain, muted tan, black, charcoal, bone white, and deep crimson palette.

Layout: Split the image visually into two zones. On the left, place a tall rectangular parchment calligraphy panel occupying about one quarter of the width, bordered with thin black ornamental lines. On the right and center, place the main character large and dramatic, standing or perched on a rocky mound, framed by a huge black circular ink-brush halo behind the skull. Add waves, smoke-like clouds, and a small Mount Fuji landscape in the lower left background. Include exactly 3 main text areas: 1 large vertical Japanese quote panel on the left, 1 small English translation block near the bottom left, and 1 small handwritten label on the briefcase at bottom right.

Main subject: A full-body human skeleton wearing a tattered dark navy-black business suit or overcoat, ornate but decayed, with frayed sleeves, ripped fabric, exposed ribs and bones, red torn necktie ribbons blowing to the right, decorative gold trim, and small hanging talismans. The skull has hollow black eye sockets and a slightly open grinning jaw. The figure holds a vintage black and brass megaphone near its mouth in the left hand; the megaphone has a small vertical paper label reading 「社畜課」. The right skeletal hand hangs down holding a battered black leather briefcase with metal corners. A vertical name tag on the character’s chest reads 「終電厳守」. Add a small black cat with glowing yellow eyes partially hidden behind the briefcase near the lower right edge.

Text content: On the left calligraphy panel, write large expressive vertical Japanese brush calligraphy: 「道を選ばずして、何が人生だ。」. Beneath it in smaller vertical Japanese text: 「武者小路実篤　生きて行く私」, plus two red seal stamps. In the lower left corner, add a small serif English translation in off-white: “To live is to choose. To choose is to risk. To risk is to become.” followed by “Saneatsu Mushanokōji” and “Ikiteyuku Watashi”. On the briefcase label, write 「本日も苦労様でした」 in rough handwritten Japanese.

Style: Intricate linework, dramatic manga-meets-ukiyo-e illustration, antique woodblock print, gritty etching detail, rough ink outlines, high contrast shadows, asymmetrical composition, ornate decayed textures, solemn but darkly humorous mood. Make it look like an old Japanese illustrated proverb poster rather than a clean digital painting.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 skeleton character, 1 megaphone, 1 briefcase, 1 black cat, 1 Mount Fuji, 1 large ink-brush circle, 2 red seal stamps, and 3 main text areas. Keep all Japanese text vertical where specified, avoid modern logos or watermarks, and do not add extra characters.\

title: 夏季世界杯韩流肖像系列详解

categories: 社交媒体帖子,头像 / 个人资料,摄影,复古 / 怀旧,肖像 / 自拍,网红 / 模特
prompt_en: Based on the uploaded clear reference photo of a single person, create a set of AI portraits themed 'Summer World Cup x Millennium Y2K x Kpop x Retro Film'. Must strictly preserve the real identity characteristics of the reference person: face shape, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, jawline, skin tone, perceived age, hairline, and overall recognizability. No face swapping, no turning into a stranger, no excessive influencer face, no anime style, and no plastic doll face. The character is set as a young adult with a bright, confident, free, and vibrant aura, like a Kpop-style street idol captured by a film camera during a summer World Cup. Style integration: World Cup football atmosphere, retro football jerseys, Y2K millennium style, summer streets, Kpop makeup and styling, youthful vitality, retro film photography, disposable camera flash, 2000s magazine photoshoot vibes. The image must not contain real team crests, official FIFA logos, real football star names, or identifiable commercial brands. Abstract flags, colorful stands, footballs, green fields, street screens, fan scarves, retro jersey numbers, and sports accessories can be used to express the World Cup atmosphere. Texture requirements: realistic photography feel, preserving natural skin texture, real pores, and natural shadows. No excessive skin smoothing or AI doll faces. Lighting should be layered, colors vibrant but high-end, with slight film grain, slight overexposure, flash texture, and a summer airy feel. Composition: 3:4 vertical, like a high-budget fashion magazine shoot, not cheap studio style, not cosplay style, and not e-commerce model style. Negative constraints: Avoid: real team crests, FIFA logos, real stars' faces, brand logos, cheap cosplay, studio portrait style, plastic skin, AI doll faces, excessive smoothing, deformed features, incorrect body proportions, deformed fingers, dead black shadows, cluttered backgrounds, stiff expressions, influencer filters, anime style, game CG style, overly sexualized, or vulgar poses. 01 | Summer Pitch Kick-off: Scene is an outdoor football pitch under the afternoon sun, with green grass, white goals, distant colorful flags, and blurred stands in the background. The character stands near the sideline, wearing a modified retro football jersey, slightly loose on top, paired with low-rise denim shorts or a sports skirt, chunky sneakers, silver earrings, colorful hair clips, and Y2K sunglasses. The character holds a football in one hand and gently brushes back wind-blown hair with the other. Expression is bright, confident, with a touch of defiance, like the main visual of a World Cup summer opening. Looking into the lens, but not a stiff pose, like a moment caught by a friend with a film camera. Light is strong natural summer afternoon light with real hard light and shadows. Healthy skin glow. Vibrant colors. Retro film grain, slight overexposure, high-budget street fashion magazine feel. 02 | Street Screen Viewing: Scene is a city street on a summer evening, with an outdoor big screen showing blurred football match footage, surrounded by young people, colorful flags, drink stalls, neon signs, and summer street crowds. No real team logos or brands. Character wears a cropped sports tank top with loose low-rise cargo pants, covered by a colorful retro sports jacket, with wired headphones, waist chains, silver bracelets, and small hairpins. Standing on the edge of the crowd, holding an iced drink or soda, with the other hand raising a small flag or fan scarf. Expression is excited yet restrained, like the second before a goal is seen. Not stiff, body has a slight turn for a street-snap feel. Light is evening natural light mixed with cold light from the screen. Face has colored reflections. Background slightly blurred. 2000s summer street film snapshot style with flash texture and grain. 03 | Kpop Stage Jersey Styling: Simple but high-end studio scene with silver metallic curtains, colorful flags, retro TVs, and footballs, looking like a Y2K Kpop stage backstage. No real team crests. Character wears a modified retro football jersey, short hem but not vulgar, paired with a pleated skirt or loose sports pants. Kpop stage styling: glitter eyeshadow, jelly lips, wet hair strands, colorful clips, silver necklaces, and headset-style accessories. Refined makeup but preserving real skin texture. Character stands in the center, leaning forward slightly, one hand touching the headset, the other holding a football. Direct eye contact, confident, bright, and in control. Flash lighting with colored rim light. Y2K magazine cover texture. Sharp colors, obvious film grain, no plastic or anime feel. 04 | Convenience Store Iced Drink Vitality: Summer convenience store entrance during the World Cup, glass doors with colorful football posters, abstract flags, and blurred signs. Vending machines or coolers nearby. No real brands. Character wears a retro jersey jacket over a white crop top, low-rise denim shorts or sports shorts, colorful sunglasses, silver waist chain. Holding an iced drink with water droplets. Hair slightly damp from sweat and humidity. Leaning against the glass door, relaxed posture, one leg slightly bent. Expression is vibrant with a real, relaxed, warm summer smile. Mix of cold white convenience store light and warm evening outdoor light. Glass reflections on face. Like a summer memory from a disposable film camera—flash, grain, overexposure, high saturation. 05 | Seaside Football Summer: Summer seaside or beach football pitch, blue sea, sand, palm trees, colorful flags, and distant people playing football. World Cup vacation vibe without official logos. Colorful retro football jersey, sports shorts or denim skirt, baseball cap or headband, Y2K sunglasses, silver jewelry. Football at feet, holding a fan scarf or transparent water bottle. Running forward and looking back at the camera, hair and clothes blowing in the wind. Bright, free, smiling. Natural body proportions. Strong seaside sunlight, healthy skin glow, slightly overexposed background, clear blue sky and sea. Retro film grain, sun flares, summer airy feel, and youth movie vibe. 06 | Night Goal Party: Night street or rooftop party, colorful string lights, blurred big screen, abstract flags, footballs, drinks, and celebrating crowd. Atmosphere of a summer night carnival after a goal. No real team logos or commercial brands. Bright Y2K sports jacket over a crop top or jersey, low-rise jeans, silver waist chain, earrings, clips, and glitter makeup. Slight sweat and messy hair for realism. One hand raising a drink or scarf, other hand on hair or waist, leaning back slightly, caught by flash. Excited, beautiful, infectious expression. Direct flash at night, bokeh background. Retro film party feel, slight motion blur, flash highlights, real grain. 07 | Retro Stand Youth: Football stadium stands with colorful seats, abstract flags, blurred fans, and green pitch. World Cup stand street-snap style. No real team logos. Sitting on a stand seat in a loose retro jersey, short skirt, sports socks, and chunky shoes (or loose jeans and sneakers). Football, backpack, headphones, and iced drink nearby. Kpop lifestyle makeup. Not sitting upright but leaning forward naturally or looking back from the side. Story-like expression, as if caught by a friend during halftime. Clear, relaxed, youthful eyes. Slanted afternoon sunlight with real shadows from seats. Film grain, slight fading, high-saturated blue-green-orange palette. 08 | Y2K Magazine Cover Close-up: Half-body to close-up composition. Blurred colorful flags, football nets, silver metallic curtains, and blue sky. 2000s Kpop + Sports magazine cover. Retro jersey or sports tank, silver chains, and fan scarf around the neck. Kpop hairstyle: naturally voluminous, wet strands, colorful clips. Makeup: clear base, glitter eyeshadow, lashes, healthy blush, jelly lips. Real skin texture. Holding a football near the face or pressing a fan scarf. Direct eye contact, confident, beautiful, slightly playful and aggressive. Front flash plus natural light, clear face, slightly overexposed background. Retro film grain, Y2K high saturation, magazine cover texture, real photography feel. 09 | Twilight Final Whistle Conclusion: Empty football pitch after dusk, orange-pink sunset sky, blurred stands/flags, footballs, scarves, and water bottles on the grass. Quiet moment after a summer World Cup match. Sitting on the grass or pitch edge, wearing a retro jersey jacket, sports tank, and denim or sports shorts. Slightly messy hair, makeup still has glitter and sweat glow. Realistic fatigue yet bright look after exercise. One hand propped behind, other holding a football, looking at the sunset. Relaxed, satisfied, quiet, but still vibrant. Golden orange sunset backlighting with rim light. Warm highlights on grass and skin. Retro film feel, slight light leaks, soft grain, youth movie ending vibe.

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a square Japanese comparison infographic showing the difference between a person who uses AI and a person who does not, in a polished semi-realistic anime business illustration style.

Canvas: 1:1 square social media image, split diagonally from near the top center toward the bottom center into two contrasting halves. Use bright warm colors on the left and dark gray-blue colors on the right. Add a clean white diagonal divider between the two scenes.

Left panel: Show a successful office worker using AI. The main subject is a young Japanese businessperson in a green shirt sitting at a wooden desk with a laptop. Place a cute small teal-and-white robot assistant beside the laptop, with “AI” written on its body. Add subtle green glow, sparkles, and a positive atmosphere. In the background, show two business colleagues standing and discussing, a bright office window, plants, and presentation materials. Deliberately obscure or softly blur all human faces for privacy-like anonymization.

Left text: At the top, place a green rounded title label reading 「AIを活用している人」. Under it, add the headline 「活躍して成果を出している！」. Include exactly 2 white thought/speech bubbles: one large bubble saying 「AIがサポートしてくれるから効率的に進められる！アイデアも広がる！」 and one smaller bubble saying 「さすが！仕事が早くて助かるよ！」. Include exactly 3 floating AI support cards around the worker: 「情報収集・要約」 with a document and magnifying glass icon, 「アイデア出し」 with a lightbulb icon, and 「資料作成サポート」 plus 「データ分析」 with chart icons. On the desk, include a gold trophy labeled 「成果・信頼 評価UP!」. At the bottom left, add a white checklist card with exactly 4 green check items: 「作業時間を大幅削減！」, 「質の高い成果を創出！」, 「評価・信頼UP！」, 「新しいことに挑戦できる！」.

Right panel: Show a stressed office worker who is not using AI. The main subject is a young Japanese businessperson in a white shirt and blue tie slumped at a desk, holding their head with one hand while looking overwhelmed at a laptop. Surround the desk with large stacks of papers, binders, and documents. The office should look dim, cold, cluttered, and late-at-night, with a wall clock, scribble stress marks, a downward-trending chart, and an exhausted mood. Deliberately obscure or softly blur the human face as on the left side.

Right text: At the top, place a dark rounded title label reading 「AIを使えていない人」. Under it, add the headline 「苦労して成果が出せず、遅れてしまう…」. Include exactly 1 large white thought bubble above the worker saying 「調べるのに時間がかかる…資料作るのも大変…終わらない…」. Include exactly 3 beige sticky notes on the wall or around the worker: 「時間がない！」, 「資料が多すぎる…」, and 「何から手をつければ…」. Add a small label near the downward chart reading 「進捗の遅れ…」. At the bottom right, add a white checklist card with exactly 4 black X items: 「作業に時間がかかり、残業続き…」, 「成果が出ず、評価が上がらない…」, 「新しいことに手が回らない…」, 「周りに差をつけられて焦る…」.

Visual style: High-quality Japanese business illustration, semi-realistic anime, clean infographic composition, crisp readable typography, soft shading, detailed office props, strong emotional contrast between success and struggle. Keep all Japanese text legible and exactly as written. No watermark, no extra logos, no additional checklist items.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a polished fantasy app asset sheet for a cozy budgeting or productivity app, showing one wide hero illustration and exactly 12 transparent PNG-style icon assets beneath it.

Canvas: Square presentation board, about 768×768 px, warm cream background with subtle paper texture and soft shadows. Use a clean app-design showcase layout with rounded cards, muted beige dividers, and a handcrafted storybook aesthetic.

Hero section: At the top, place a wide panoramic illustration labeled Hero Art. The hero image should depict a whimsical hobbit-style hillside cottage in a golden countryside at sunset: a mossy green grass roof, round teal-green wooden door, two glowing circular windows, stone path leading toward the door, wildflowers and vines around the entrance, rolling hills and valleys in the background, a rustic fence on the left, soft warm sky, painterly watercolor/gouache finish. Under the hero title, include the line: 'hero-cottage-wide.png' is the accepted wide generated PNG hero baseline.

Asset grid: Below the hero section, create exactly 12 rounded asset cards arranged in 2 rows of 6. Each card has a checkerboard transparency preview area on top and a white/cream label area at the bottom. The icons should be isolated, painterly, warm fantasy UI assets with transparent PNG presentation.

The 12 cards, in order from left to right, top row then bottom row:
1. Hero cottage wide generated PNG — miniature wide crop of the cottage landscape; description: Wide crop-safe hand-painted cottage scene.
2. Botanical vine transparent PNG — delicate flowering vine branch; description: Primary painterly vine ornament.
3. Botanical sprig buds transparent PNG — small vertical sprig with antique-gold buds; description: Small distinct sprig with antique-gold buds.
4. Botanical corner cluster transparent PNG — corner ornament with white flowers and tendrils; description: Corner ornament with flowers and tendrils.
5. Balance seedling seal transparent PNG — circular gold coin/seal with a simple green seedling symbol; description: Balance-card seedling coin.
6. Metric spend wallet metric card icons PNG — small brown leather wallet with a strap, coin, and sprout; description: Monthly spend wallet icon.
7. Metric savings leaf metric card icons PNG — round green medallion with white leaf symbol and tiny sparkles; description: Savings leaf icon.
8. Metric bills calendar metric card icons PNG — small calendar icon with golden binding and flowers; description: Upcoming bills calendar icon.
9. Tab home cottage tab bar icons PNG — small round-door cottage entrance icon; description: Home tab pictorial icon.
10. Tab accounts chest tab bar icons PNG — small golden treasure chest with green accents; description: Accounts/chest tab icon.
11. Tab add plus tab bar icons PNG — green circular medallion with a cream plus sign; description: Central add/plus medallion.
12. Tab goals pot tab bar icons PNG — terracotta flower pot with a small green sprout; description: Goals/pot tab icon.

Visual style: Soft storybook watercolor and gouache rendering, warm golden lighting, earthy greens, cream, ochre, moss, and teal accents. Icons should look like cohesive app assets from the same design system, with subtle shadows, hand-painted edges, and high readability at small sizes.

Text style: Use clear bold dark serif or semi-serif titles on each card, with smaller gray descriptive text beneath. Keep the filename/category phrasing readable and aligned consistently.

Constraints: Use exactly one top hero panel and exactly 12 asset cards. Keep all icon previews on checkerboard transparency backgrounds. No extra assets, no people, no watermark. The app theme should feel like cozy hobbit finance app, with the main door color teal green and overall palette warm golden countryside greens and creams.\

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 illustration, full-bleed, soft high-key lighting, airy pastel palette of aqua, bubblegum pink, cream, lavender, and lemon yellow. Use delicate line art, watercolor-like shading, glossy highlights, and a cute 1990s shoujo-anime summer aesthetic.

Main subject: Center the character from hips upward, turned slightly to the left with her back and shoulder visible. She has dark navy-black wavy hair in a high ponytail, tied with a large pink gingham bow. Add small star hair clips near the ponytail. Her face area is intentionally covered by a centered opaque square censor block with a muted gray-to-pale-pink vertical gradient, obscuring facial features. She raises one hand to adjust pink-framed sunglasses on her head. She wears a frilly sleeveless white summer top with pale blue polka dots, ruffled straps, an open-back cut, and a tied bow at the lower back, plus a high-waisted pink skirt with visible pockets and a turquoise belt.

Floating summer objects: Include exactly 13 discrete surrounding props: 1 pink-framed sunglasses pair at upper left, 1 turquoise popsicle on a wooden stick at left, 1 large pink-and-white life preserver at upper right, 1 yellow beach ball near the top, 1 blue spiral seashell at right, 1 orange slice at mid-right, 1 tall turquoise lemonade glass with straw and lemon slice at lower right, 1 pink-and-white beach ball at bottom right, 1 pastel striped swim ring at bottom left, 1 pink seashell at lower left, 1 yellow starfish at lower left, 1 large sunflower at bottom left, and 1 pink bow near the sunflower.

Background: Fill the backdrop with a cheerful collage of beach graphics: teal wave patterns, grid paper texture, diagonal pastel shapes, confetti dots, small stars, abstract paint splashes, and a few palm leaves entering from the top-left corner. The composition should feel packed but balanced, like a decorative summer postcard.

Text: Add a small handwritten-style signature at the bottom right reading Oyagi, with the date June 23, 2026 just above it.

Constraints: Keep everything in English except the signature if customized. No photorealism, no dark shadows, no extra people, no additional large text, no watermark beyond the tiny signature/date. Maintain the face-covering square exactly over the face area.\
